scope: Give the menu bar an exponential dark fade and rounded display corners, and guide pointer motion along the visible curve on Wayland.
approval: The maintainer approved publication to both editions after reviewing the final menu bar and corner clearance preview.

checks.command: Ran 27 focused checks covering menu geometry, component caching, installation of the Global Menu module, and Acrylic Glass regions.
Built the native effects with KWin 6.6.4, 6.7.4 and 6.8.1 SDKs. Also built the X11 target with the 6.6 and 6.7.4 SDKs.
Ran the existing isolated native X11 Xvfb render probe with the 6.6 build. The approved exempt surface retained pixel identity across the effect toggle.

Loaded the compiled menu bar and Acrylic Glass into KDE neon Plasma 6.8.1 Wayland at 2x. Exercised pointer motion at both top corners and clicked the system menu and clock. Captured both edition wallpapers with light and dark appearances.
Verified Golden Gate local-source staging, the component hash ledger, git diff --check, and byte identity of the tested runtime with the release candidate.

coverage_limits: Wayland pointer and panel rendering were exercised on one display. X11 was checked with an isolated existing compositor render probe and retains its standard pointer behavior. Installer lifecycle code was unchanged.
